formats.key: swap(address caller, (address srcToken, address dstToken, address srcReceiver, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags, bytes permit) desc, bytes data)
effects: The signer pays desc.amount of desc.srcToken: as ETH in msg.value when srcToken is ETH, or pulled with transferFrom(msg.sender, desc.srcReceiver, desc.amount) when the SHOULD_CLAIM flag is set.

When the REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH flag is set, msg.value only has to be greater than desc.amount (or greater than 0 for an ERC-20 source). All of msg.value is forwarded to the executor `caller`, so extra ETH leaves the signer's wallet.
When SHOULD_CLAIM is set and desc.permit is 224 bytes, the router submits the signer's EIP-2612 permit on srcToken, which sets the router's allowance to the permit value.
The beneficiary (desc.dstReceiver, or msg.sender when it is zero) receives desc.dstToken. The router checks that the beneficiary's balance rose by at least desc.minReturnAmount.

When the PARTIAL_FILL flag is set, the router may spend less than desc.amount, and the minimum is applied as a rate (returnAmount*amount >= minReturnAmount*spent). The signer can then receive less than minReturnAmount.
Routing is done by the executor `caller` with the opaque `data`. The source tokens go to desc.srcReceiver.
formats.shown: "Swap", then Amount to Send (desc.amount in srcToken), Minimum to Receive (minReturnAmount in dstToken) and Beneficiary (dstReceiver). Flags, permit, srcReceiver, executor and data are hidden.

findings.title: swap is payable and has no @.value field; the REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH flag lets ETH above desc.amount leave unshown
findings.evidence: AggregationRouterV3.sol swap(): `if (flags & _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH != 0) { require(msg.value > (srcToken.isETH() ? desc.amount : 0) ...` then `address(caller).call{value: msg.value}`. In the descriptor, `desc.flags` is visible: never and there is no `@.value` field, so only desc.amount is shown.
findings.fix: Add a field `@.value` with format `amount` (label "ETH sent"). Or show desc.flags with a bitflag/enum and a label that names extra ETH.

findings.title: swap shows minReturnAmount as an absolute minimum, but the hidden PARTIAL_FILL flag makes it a rate
findings.evidence: swap(): `if (flags & _PARTIAL_FILL != 0) { spentAmount = ...; require(returnAmount.mul(desc.amount) >= desc.minReturnAmount.mul(spentAmount) ...`. The descriptor labels desc.minReturnAmount "Minimum to Receive" and hides desc.flags.
findings.fix: Show desc.flags (at least the partial-fill bit), or change the label to say the minimum scales down with a partial fill.

findings.title: swap Beneficiary shows the zero address literally, but the code then pays msg.sender
findings.evidence: swap(): `address dstReceiver = (desc.dstReceiver == address(0)) ? msg.sender : desc.dstReceiver;`. The descriptor field `desc.dstReceiver` uses addressName with no sender mapping.
findings.fix: Add `senderAddress: ["$.metadata.constants.addressAsNull"]` to the beneficiary field so a zero address shows as the signer.

findings.title: swap intent is only "Swap" with no interpolatedIntent naming the amount, tokens or recipient
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Swap {desc.amount} for at least {desc.minReturnAmount} to {desc.dstReceiver}".

findings.title: swap hides the srcReceiver, the executor and the permit that send the source tokens and set the router allowance
findings.evidence: swap(): `_permit(srcToken, desc.amount, desc.permit); srcToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, desc.srcReceiver, desc.amount);`. Descriptor: `desc.srcReceiver`, `desc.permit`, `caller` and `data` are all visible: never. The output token, recipient and minimum are shown and enforced by the balance check, and the permit approves the named router (prerequisite of the swap).
findings.fix: Optional: show desc.srcReceiver as "Source tokens sent to".

cases.notes: The mined tx reverted (status 0). The only signer effect in the trace is 0.04 ETH out, which the screen shows as "0.04 ETH". Beneficiary equals the signer. The flags word is 0, so msg.value == desc.amount and there is no partial fill.

formats.key: unoswap(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools)
effects: The signer pays `amount` of srcToken. When srcToken is zero this is ETH, and msg.value must equal amount; the router wraps it to WETH and sends it to the first pair. Otherwise msg.value must be 0, and the router does transferFrom(caller, firstPair, amount).
The swap runs through the packed Uniswap-V2-style pairs in `pools`. The output token is set by the last pair and its direction bit, and is not in the calldata.
The signer (msg.sender) receives the output token. When the WETH bit of the last pool is set, the router unwraps WETH and sends ETH to the signer instead.
The call reverts if the output is below minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap", then Amount to Send (amount in srcToken, ETH when zero), Minimum to Receive as a bare integer with no token, and Beneficiary = the signer. The pools are hidden.

findings.title: unoswap Minimum to Receive has no token and renders as a bare integer; the received AKITA is unnamed
findings.evidence: descriptor unoswap: `{"path": "minReturn", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.minReceiveAmount"}` with no tokenPath. Case 1 screen: "Minimum to Receive": "4957007923890945718204719". Mined: 390472947688183179397132477 AKITA (0x3301ee63...) in to the signer.
findings.fix: Show the last pool as in unoswapWithPermit (`pools.[-1].[-20:]` as addressName), and label the minimum as raw units of the token output by that pool.

findings.title: unoswap output token (or unwrapped ETH) is decided by the pool and cannot be named from calldata
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter.unoswap(): the final `swap(..., caller())` or the `_WETH_MASK` branch `call(gas(), caller(), returnAmount, ...)`. The output token is token0/token1 of the last pair, which is pool storage. Case 1: AKITA arrives and the screen names no asset.
findings.fix: Not fixable in ERC-7730 today. Showing the last pool address is the best available hint.

findings.title: unoswap intent is only "Swap", and pools is hidden while the sibling format shows the last pool
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent "Swap {amount}" and show the last pool's address.

cases.notes: ETH out 0.00414225 is shown correctly. AKITA in: only a raw minimum with no asset. The reader thought the output goes to someone else because the test's `from` (0x7E5F...) differs from the mined signer. That is a harness artefact; @.from is the signer in practice.

formats.key: unoswapWithPermit(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools, bytes permit)
effects: If permit is 224 bytes, the router submits the signer's EIP-2612 permit on srcToken, which sets an allowance of the permit value. If the permit call fails and the existing allowance is below amount, the call reverts.
The signer pays `amount` of srcToken (pulled to the first pair with transferFrom, or ETH wrapped to WETH when srcToken is zero and msg.value == amount).
The swap runs through the packed pairs. The signer receives the output token, or ETH when the last pool's WETH bit is set.
The call reverts if the output is below minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap", then Amount to Send (amount in srcToken), Minimum to Receive as a bare integer with no token, Beneficiary = the signer, and Last pool (the packed bytes32 rendered as addressName). The permit is hidden.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit Minimum to Receive has no token and renders as a bare integer
findings.evidence: descriptor unoswapWithPermit: `{"path": "minReturn", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.minReceiveAmount"}` with no tokenPath. The output token is set by the last pair in UnoswapRouter.unoswap().
findings.fix: Label it as raw units of the token output by the last pool. The token itself cannot be resolved from calldata.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit Last pool applies addressName to a packed bytes32 that holds flag and fee bits
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter.unoswap(): `and(rawPair, _ADDRESS_MASK)`, `_REVERSE_MASK`, `_WETH_MASK`, `_NUMERATOR_MASK`. The descriptor has `"path": "pools.[-1]"` with `lastPool` addressName and no slice.
findings.fix: Use `pools.[-1].[-20:]` so only the pair address is formatted.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit hides the permit, so the allowance value it sets for the router is not shown
findings.evidence: Permitable._permit(): `address(token).call(abi.encodePacked(IERC20Permit.permit.selector, permit))`. Descriptor: `{"label": "Permit", "path": "permit", "visible": "never"}`. It approves the named router for the swap it performs (prerequisite).
findings.fix: Optional: show the permit value with `permit.[64:96]` as a tokenAmount on srcToken.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit output token is decided by the last pool and cannot be named from calldata
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter.unoswap(): the output is token0/token1 of the last pair, optionally unwrapped to ETH via `_WETH_MASK`.

findings.title: swap is payable and has no @.value field; the REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH flag lets ETH above desc.amount leave unshown

The swap format has no @.value field and hides desc.flags with visible: never, so the extra ETH that leaves the wallet is never shown. Only desc.amount appears, as 'Amount to Send'.

findings.title: unoswap is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: unoswap() makes the ETH sent match a shown value or be zero. When srcToken is the zero address, callvalue must equal amount. The 'Amount to Send' field shows that amount as native currency, because nativeCurrencyAddress includes addressAsNull. For any other srcToken, a non-zero callvalue reverts.
findings.quote: UnoswapRouter.unoswap(): `case 0 { if iszero(eq(amount, callvalue())) { revertWithReason(... "invalid msg.value") } ... } default { if callvalue() { revertWithReason(... "invalid msg.value") } ...}`; descriptor sendAmount: `"nativeCurrencyAddress": ["$.metadata.constants.addressAsEth", "$.metadata.constants.addressAsNull"]`

findings.format: unoswapWithPermit(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools, bytes permit)
findings.title: unoswapWithPermit is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: unoswapWithPermit() calls _permit and then unoswap(), so the same callvalue checks apply. msg.value must equal the shown amount when srcToken is the zero address, and must be zero for any other token. No ETH leaves beyond the 'Amount to Send' field.
findings.quote: UnoswapRouter.unoswapWithPermit(): `_permit(srcToken, amount, permit); return unoswap(srcToken, amount, minReturn, pools);` → unoswap(): `if iszero(eq(amount, callvalue()))` / `if callvalue() { revertWithReason(...) }`

findings.title: swap is payable and has no @.value field; the REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH flag lets ETH above desc.amount leave unshown

findings.format: unoswap(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools)
findings.title: unoswap is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: For native input, unoswap requires msg.value to equal the displayed amount; for token input, it rejects nonzero msg.value. The native value is therefore shown through another field.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x11111112542d85b3ef69ae05771c2dccff4faa26/src/AggregationRouterV3.sol, unoswap(): `case 0 { if iszero(eq(amount, callvalue())) { revertWithReason(0x00000011696e76616c6964206d73672e76616c75650000000000000000000000, 0x55) }` and `default { if callvalue() { revertWithReason(0x00000011696e76616c6964206d73672e76616c75650000000000000000000000, 0x55) }`. descriptor.json, unoswap: `"path": "amount", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.sendAmount", "params": { "tokenPath": "srcToken" }, "visible": "always"`. cases/1.json, screen: `"label": "Amount to Send", "value": "0.00414225 ETH"`.

findings.format: unoswapWithPermit(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools, bytes permit)
findings.title: unoswapWithPermit is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: unoswapWithPermit internally calls unoswap, preserving msg.value and its checks. Nonzero native value must equal the displayed native amount; token input rejects it.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x11111112542d85b3ef69ae05771c2dccff4faa26/src/AggregationRouterV3.sol, unoswapWithPermit(): `_permit(srcToken, amount, permit); return unoswap(srcToken, amount, minReturn, pools);`. unoswap(): `if iszero(eq(amount, callvalue())) { revertWithReason(0x00000011696e76616c6964206d73672e76616c75650000000000000000000000, 0x55) }`; token branch: `if callvalue() { revertWithReason(0x00000011696e76616c6964206d73672e76616c75650000000000000000000000, 0x55) }`. descriptor.json, unoswapWithPermit: `"path": "amount", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.sendAmount", "params": { "tokenPath": "srcToken" }, "visible": "always"`; sendAmount labels it `"Amount to Send"` and recognizes the zero address as native currency.
